summary: Horizontally scrolling ticker text, for when shrinking the font is the wrong answer.
overview: Scrolls text that is too long for its box, as the alternative to auto-shrinking — right for a long item name, a news ticker or a marquee credit line. It requires a RectMask2D on the object so the text is actually clipped.
useCases: A long item or track name in a narrow strip.

params.tuning: Leave on. Text that already fits should sit still, not drift for no reason.
Zero makes the end run straight into the beginning, which is unreadable.

gotchas.title: It needs a RectMask2D
gotchas.body: Without one the text scrolls outside its box and over its neighbours.

gotchas.title: Scrolling text is hard to read
gotchas.body: It is the right answer for a name or a ticker, and the wrong one for anything the player must read carefully.
